title: Apical activity and its thalamic targets gate detection of threshold stimuli

statements.text: In mice detecting weak whisker stimuli, apical calcium signals in layer 5 neurons tracked and predicted detection, suppressing apical dendritic processes suppressed detection, and suppressing the subcortical targets of these neurons, chiefly higher-order thalamus, did the same.

sources.quote: Suppressing these apical dendritic processes (e.g., dendritic calcium spikes) in pyramidal neurons suppresses conscious perception.
the apical dendritic signals could predict the behavioral hits and misses of threshold stimuli
